correctness.rationale: Exact symbolic integration over two independent barycentric simplex pairs yields m1=e1/18, m2=(e1^2-2e2)/60, m3=(23e1^3-62e1e2+20e3)/4200. Heron identity and sum-of-squares give exact realizability; the cosine parametrization describes all fibers. e3 has a cubic cos(3theta) contribution, proving the entire sharp sixth-moment interval, isosceles endpoints, and unique three-moment recovery. An explicit exact two-moment collision establishes the cutoff. A Rouché-root perturbation bound yields an optimal 1/3 inverse Hölder exponent, with a near-equilateral matching lower obstruction. Exact checker and independent quadrature passed.

value.rationale: Complete low-dimensional rotation-invariant inverse-distance tomography is a natural question. The exact feasible 3-moment region tells which measurements can arise from a triangle, classifies the ambiguity left by only two moments and sharp third-moment extremizers, and determines the optimal ill-conditioning exponent near equilateral shapes. Its natural exact-shape classification and best-possible inverse stability are not mere forward-moment recomputations; no general polygon or statistical-noise theorem is claimed.
